decisions.reason: Separate calendar management is part of location operational isolation and does not change the candidate's Wix Bookings platform requirement.
Per-location calendar separation does not change the master site's location presentation, routing, or navigation behavior.
The operational separation of calendars does not alter the reusable template structure for onboarding location sites.
Calendar isolation between locations does not change the shared Smash Room brand identity or its application.
The source decision concerns operational calendar separation and does not change the visual design reference or layout characteristics.
